name: review-3420
description: Avoid having server.h being included by cli and benchmark
author: ranshid

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body:
Is this GCC and Clang only or is it C standard?

Just curios. We have multiple `__attribute__((...))` already.

maintainer_comments.author: ranshid
maintainer_comments.body:
>Is this GCC and Clang only or is it C standard?

Yes. this is a gcc extension which is supported by clang (not C standard)

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body: I've seen some attempt to build with other compilers, but they'll have to support this too. We already have this kind of attributes, many of them.

maintainer_comments.author: ranshid
maintainer_comments.body: So what do you suggest? should I macro it in config.h?

maintainer_comments.author: zuiderkwast
maintainer_comments.body: No, let's keep `__attribute__((always_inline))`. We already have many such attributes already, so nothing will break by this. 😄
